heading.zh-Hant: 出生、海軍生涯與受封約克公爵
heading.en: Birth, naval career and creation as Duke of York

body.zh-Hant: 喬治五世1865年6月3日生於馬爾堡府，是威爾斯親王夫婦（日後的愛德華七世與亞歷山德拉王后）的次子。1877年他與兄長阿爾伯特·維克多一同成為海軍學員。1892年1月，兄長猝逝使他成為王位的直接繼承人，海軍生涯就此中止；同年5月24日，他受封約克公爵。
body.en: George V was born on 3 June 1865 at Marlborough House, the second son of the Prince and Princess of Wales (later Edward VII and Queen Alexandra). In 1877 he and his elder brother Prince Albert Victor became naval cadets. In January 1892 the sudden death of his brother put him in the direct line of succession and ended his naval career; on 24 May 1892 he was created Duke of York.

heading.zh-Hant: 婚姻、受封威爾斯親王與繼位
heading.en: Marriage, creation as Prince of Wales and accession

body.zh-Hant: 1893年7月6日，他在聖詹姆斯宮的皇家禮拜堂與特克的維多利亞·瑪麗成婚。1901年1月23日維多利亞女王駕崩後，他陪同父王出席新朝第一次樞密院會議，並是第一個宣誓效忠新王的人。1901年11月9日，愛德華七世封他為威爾斯親王；1905至1906年間，他前往印度與緬甸訪問。1910年5月6日父王去世，他被宣布為國王喬治五世。
body.en: On 6 July 1893 he married Princess Victoria Mary of Teck at the Chapel Royal, St James's Palace. After Queen Victoria's death on 23 January 1901 he accompanied his father to the first Privy Council of the new reign and was the first to swear allegiance to the new King. On 9 November 1901 Edward VII created him Prince of Wales, and in 1905–1906 he visited India and Burma. After his father's death on 6 May 1910 he was proclaimed King George V.

heading.zh-Hant: 登基、議會法案與第一次世界大戰
heading.en: Accession, the Parliament Bill and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 喬治五世1911年6月22日在西敏寺加冕。他登基之初正逢上議院否決權的憲政危機；1911年議會法案在未大量冊封貴族的情況下於上議院通過。同年他前往印度，是唯一親自訪印的英國君主兼皇帝。1914年第一次世界大戰爆發，他曾探訪部隊超過450次、探訪醫院超過300次。1917年，他因反德情緒改用溫莎為王室姓氏。
body.en: George V was crowned at Westminster Abbey on 22 June 1911. His reign began amid the constitutional crisis over the House of Lords' veto, and in 1911 the Parliament Bill was passed by the Lords without a mass creation of peers. He visited India that year, the only monarch to do so as King-Emperor. When the First World War broke out in 1914 he made over 450 visits to troops and over 300 visits to hospitals. In 1917 anti-German feeling led him to adopt Windsor as the family name.

heading.zh-Hant: 愛爾蘭自由邦、工黨政府與晚年
heading.en: The Irish Free State, the first Labour government and his last years

body.zh-Hant: 1922年愛爾蘭自由邦成立，北部六郡仍屬聯合王國，他在此事上扮演調和角色。1924年他接受首屆工黨政府；1929年世界經濟衰退後，他說服工黨領袖領導全黨派國民政府，該政府贏得1931年大選。1931年的威斯敏斯特規約使各自治領議會可不經聯合王國立法而自行立法。1932年起他每年發表聖誕廣播，1935年舉行登基銀禧慶典。他於1936年1月20日去世，長子愛德華繼位。
body.en: In 1922 the Irish Free State was set up while the six northern counties remained part of the United Kingdom, and George played a conciliatory role. He readily accepted the first Labour government in 1924; after the world slump of 1929 he persuaded the Labour leader to head an all-party National Government, which won the 1931 election. The Statute of Westminster of 1931 let Dominion parliaments pass laws without reference to United Kingdom laws. From 1932 he gave the annual Christmas Broadcast, and in 1935 he celebrated his Silver Jubilee. He died on 20 January 1936 and his eldest son Edward succeeded him.

people.name: Augusto Tasso Fragoso
people.nameZh: 奧古斯托·塔索·弗拉戈索

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、軍校與共和政變之夜
heading.en: Birth, the military academy and the night of the Republic's proclamation

body.zh-Hant: 奧古斯托·塔索·弗拉戈索1869年8月28日生於聖路易斯，父親是葡萄牙裔商人，兼任葡萄牙駐馬拉尼昂領事。官方文件記載他生於1867年，原因是其父為讓他早日投身軍旅而更動年份。1885年3月，他入讀普拉亞·維梅利亞軍校。1889年11月14日夜，他得知騎兵第二旅與軍校學員準備上街宣告共和，便穿上軍服、帶著武器趕往學校。
body.en: Augusto Tasso Fragoso was born in São Luís on 28 August 1869, the son of a merchant of Portuguese origin who was also Portugal's consul in Maranhão. His official documents give 1867 as his birth year because his father had altered it so that he could start a military career earlier. In March 1885 he entered the Praia Vermelha Military School. On the night of 14 November 1889 he learned that the 2nd Cavalry Brigade and the cadets were preparing to take to the streets and proclaim the Republic, and he went to the school in uniform and armed.

heading.zh-Hant: 負傷、軍事辦公室主任與晉升將官
heading.en: Wounded in 1894, head of the Military Household and promotion to general officer

body.zh-Hant: 1894年2月9日，他在尼泰羅伊的阿爾馬桑戰鬥中負傷，隨後因勇敢晉升上尉。1914至1917年他出任總統文塞斯勞·布拉斯的軍事辦公室主任。1918年1月他晉升旅級將軍（general-de-brigada）並出任騎兵第四旅指揮官；1922年2月再晉升師級將軍（general-de-divisão）。
body.en: On 9 February 1894 he was wounded in the combat of Armação at Niterói and was then promoted to captain for bravery. From 1914 to 1917 he was head of the Military Household of President Venceslau Brás. In January 1918 he was promoted to brigadier general (general-de-brigada) and named commander of the 4th Cavalry Brigade; in February 1922 he became a divisional general (general-de-divisão).

heading.en: Chief of the Army General Staff, 1922–1929

body.zh-Hant: 1922年11月，在阿圖爾·貝爾納德斯政府初期，他被任命為陸軍總參謀部（EME）主任。1923年2月，他率軍事使團隨巴西代表團出席在智利聖地牙哥舉行的第五屆美洲國際會議。他公開主張陸軍不介入政黨政治；後來因總參謀部被排除在軍事教育改革計畫之外，他於1929年1月辭職。
body.en: In November 1922, early in Artur Bernardes's government, he was appointed chief of the Army General Staff (EME). In February 1923 he led the military mission that accompanied the Brazilian delegation to the 5th Inter-American Conference in Santiago, Chile. He publicly argued that the Army should stay out of party politics; later, with the General Staff sidelined from the military-education restructuring programme, he resigned in January 1929.

heading.en: President of the 1930 Provisional Governing Junta

body.zh-Hant: 梅納·巴雷托提議由現役最資深的軍官塔索·弗拉戈索領導推翻總統的軍事行動。1930年10月23日夜，兩人在科帕卡巴納堡會面，協調最後準備；次日上午前往瓜納巴拉宮。臨時執政委員會隨即成立，由他擔任主席，成員為梅納·巴雷托與海軍少將何塞·伊薩亞斯·德·諾羅尼亞。10月24日下午五時，華盛頓·路易斯同意離任，被送往科帕卡巴納堡。他與瓦加斯約定於11月3日移交權力並組成臨時政府。
body.en: Mena Barreto proposed that Tasso Fragoso, as the most senior active-duty officer, lead the military operation to depose the president. On the night of 23 October 1930 the two met at Fort Copacabana to coordinate the final preparations, and the next morning they went to Guanabara Palace. A provisional governing junta was then formed, presided over by Tasso Fragoso, with Mena Barreto and Rear Admiral José Isaías de Noronha. At five in the afternoon of 24 October Washington Luís agreed to leave office and was taken to Fort Copacabana. Tasso Fragoso agreed with Vargas that power would be transferred on 3 November with the formation of a provisional government.

heading.zh-Hant: 再任總參謀部主任、最高軍事法院與晚年
heading.en: Second term at the General Staff, the Supreme Military Tribunal and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1931年3月31日，臨時政府再度任命他為陸軍總參謀部主任。1932年7月9日聖保羅立憲革命爆發後，他抱怨自己被排除在決策之外，隨即請辭，由貝內迪托·奧林皮奧·達·西爾韋拉接任。1933至1938年他擔任最高軍事法院（STM）大法官，1938年2月因年齡上限強制退休。他於1945年9月20日在里約熱內盧去世。
body.en: On 31 March 1931 the Provisional Government again appointed him chief of the Army General Staff. After the Constitutionalist Revolution in São Paulo broke out on 9 July 1932 he complained of being sidelined from decisions and then resigned; General Benedito Olímpio da Silveira was named to replace him. From 1933 to 1938 he was a minister of the Supreme Military Tribunal (STM), and he was compulsorily retired at the age limit in February 1938. He died in Rio de Janeiro on 20 September 1945.

representante a la Cámara; senador;

febrero 14 de 1917
